noWarn.description:
List of warnings to ignore.

- Default: `[]`.

modelRoot.description:
Path to the root directory containing all model tmd files loaded by the generator (except the domains file, which is loaded separately). If omitted, the directory containing the configuration file is used.

- Default: directory containing the configuration file.

modelFilePaths.description:
When set, TopModel loads only model files matching the listed glob patterns (relative to `modelRoot`).

- Default: `["**/*.tmd"]`.

language.description: Language of technical labels written in generated content. This setting is independent of the `i18n` section (which controls localization of business labels) and the console message language (which always matches the OS language).

pluralizeTableNames.description:
Uses pluralized class names to generate SQL table names.

- Default: `false`.

defaultAssociationUseClass.description:
Sets the default `useClass` value for association properties in the model.

- Default: `false`.

rootPath.description:
Path template for incoming translation directories. Must contain the `{lang}` token.

- Default: `{lang}`.
- Templating: `{lang}`.

defaultLang.description:
Default application language. Leave empty if the application has only one unnamed language. A null value disables the default language and the use of labels defined in the model in a default language.

- Default: `""`.

langs.description:
Application languages other than the default language, identified by code.

- Default: `[]`.

translateReferences.description:
Whether reference list labels must be translated.

- Default: `true`.

translateProperties.description:
Whether property labels must be translated.

- Default: `true`.

allowPropertyLabelFallback.description:
When a property label is not set, allows its name to be used as the label.

- Default: `true`.

generators.description:
Paths to C# projects containing custom generators.

- Default: `[]`.

ignoredFiles.description:
Files to ignore after the first generation (relative to the configuration file).

- Default: `[]`.

path.description: Path of the file to ignore, relative to the configuration file.
